papers.title: Designing AI-Mediated Communication in Teams
papers.abstract: AI assistants increasingly participate in work that requires employees to exchange information and coordinate decisions. We study how a firm should design this communication when workers' interests conflict with each other's and the firm's. Two workers privately know local conditions and their preferred responses, while the assistant knows aggregate project conditions. The firm discloses project information before workers report and choose their own actions. Transparency improves adaptation but can undermine truthful preference reporting. When workers agree with the firm on the productive direction, coarsening project information under weak coordination can preserve useful preference reporting at a cost in forecast precision. Under strong coordination, the firm instead prefers full project disclosure and factual reports, because preference information induces costly accommodation of private objectives. Under weak coordination, a firm-optimal policy can leave workers worse off than direct exchange; requiring their acceptance can call for further coarsening. Releasing project context after reports can sustain factual communication that early release would prevent. With separate delivery decisions that cannot be revised jointly, endogenous forwarding weakly improves firm-preferred performance over unchanged forwarding and strictly improves it in some environments. Numerical comparisons show that full initial disclosure captures most gains in the aligned environments considered, while further design has greater value when workers can favor opposing directions. The results distinguish the credibility of employees' reports from their organizational value and show how disclosure timing affects both.

papers.title: Tight Analysis of Randomized Truthful Scheduling: An $(m+1)/2$ Lower Bound
papers.abstract: The Nisan-Ronen conjecture, a central problem in algorithmic game theory, asserts that no deterministic truthful mechanism for makespan minimization on $m$ unrelated machines can achieve an approximation ratio better than $m$. Christodoulou, Koutsoupias, and Kovács resolved it in 2023, but the optimal approximation ratio achievable by randomized truthful mechanisms remained open. Recently, Anastasiadis, Christodoulou, Koutsoupias, Kovács, and Schecker extended techniques from the deterministic proof to establish a $(3/2-\sqrt{2})(m-1)$ lower bound for universally truthful mechanisms with discrete support and gave a universally truthful mechanism with approximation ratio $m/2+o(m)$. For the broader class of truthful-in-expectation (TIE) mechanisms, however, the gap remained large: the best known upper bound was $(m+5)/2$, while the lower bound was only $2-1/m$. We prove a lower bound of $(m+1)/2$, determining the optimal TIE approximation ratio up to an additive constant as $m/2+Θ(1)$. Our result also improves the leading constant in the lower bound for universally truthful mechanisms from $3/2-\sqrt{2} \approx 0.0858$ to $1/2$. Together with their $m/2+o(m)$ upper bound, our result determines the optimal approximation ratio for universally truthful mechanisms up to lower-order terms.

papers.title: Sharp Bounds for Truthful-in-Expectation Scheduling
papers.abstract: We study randomized mechanisms for scheduling indivisible jobs on $n$ unrelated machines. Each machine is controlled by a selfish agent who privately knows its processing time for each job. A mechanism assigns every job to a machine and makes payments. We require truthfulness in expectation: no agent can increase its expected payment minus its expected processing cost by misreporting, regardless of the other agents' reports. The makespan is the maximum total processing time assigned to a machine; the objective is to minimize its expectation. We prove that the optimal approximation ratio is $(n+1)/2$ for every $n\ge7$, relative to the minimum makespan of an integral assignment. The lower bound holds for every $n$ and allows unrestricted computation and arbitrary correlations among assignments, assuming finite expected payments and a guarantee uniform over all finite job counts. The matching mechanism uses correlated rounding and runs in expected polynomial bit time on rational inputs. These guarantees hold for all finite nonnegative processing times. For two machines, we characterize the optimal approximation ratio exactly as an analytic constant, approximately $1.505995705434$, and give a mechanism attaining it. For three machines the optimal ratio is $2$. For four, five, and six machines we obtain upper bounds of $3$, $105/32$, and $29/8$, respectively, compared with the general lower bound $(n+1)/2$. The proofs for $n\ge7$ do not rely on computer-assisted certificates; the two- and three-machine results use exact rational computer-assisted certificates.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 研究问题是设计随机机制来调度不可分割任务到自私机器上，在保证机器如实报告处理时间的前提下最小化期望最大负载。传统确定性机制性能比下界猜想已被解决，但随机机制的最优性能比仍不清楚。本文聚焦于真话期望（TIE）机制，探究其近似比随机器数增长的精确行为，填补了该方向的理论空白。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型包含n台机器和m个任务，每台机器私有知晓各任务在其上的处理时间。机制通过分配任务并支付报酬，使机器如实报告成为占优策略。目标是最小化期望最大负载与最优整数调度最小最大负载之比。采用真话期望（TIE）均衡概念，允许机制使用随机性，并关注任意相关作业分配下的最优近似比。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明了对于n≥7台机器，最优TIE机制的近似比恰好为(n+1)/2，且该界可通过相关舍入机制达到。对于两台和三台机器，分别给出了精确常数约1.505995705434和2。四至六台机器也提供了优于一般下界的上界。这解决了长期开放问题，表明TIE机制的性能损失随机器数线性增长。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 证明结合了下界构造与上界机制设计。下界基于扰动星形实例和局部性定理，利用极限族将单任务概率迁移到多任务场景。上界采用带槽位舍入的相关舍入技术，保持Bounded-Square分配概率的同时控制负载分布。通过联合几何分析与协方差估计，实现了紧确界分析。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果依赖于期望真话均衡，不适用于更弱的均衡概念。机制虽高效可实现，但最优性仅在特定机器数下完全刻画。最值得阅读的是其紧确界分析方法与相关舍入技术，为后续研究提供了新工具。开放问题包括中间机器数的精确值及更通用模型下的扩展。

papers.title: On the Complexity of Exact Autobidding Equilibria
papers.titleZh: 关于精确自动竞价均衡的复杂性
papers.abstract: Autobidding equilibria link advertisers' value multipliers or participation probabilities through aggregate budget and return-on-investment (ROI) constraints. We establish the exact computational complexity of finding these equilibria across several canonical settings: exact equilibrium computation is $\mathsf{FIXP}$-complete for second-price ROI pacing, budget- or ROI-constrained generalized second-price (GSP) sponsored shopping, and second-price throttling. Furthermore, approximating the equilibrium control vector in distance to a true equilibrium is $\mathsf{FIXP}_{a}$-complete when the target accuracy is provided as input.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现代在线广告平台广泛使用自动竞价，广告主设定预算或投资回报率（ROI）目标，系统自动生成投标。这种全局约束下的竞价行为会引发复杂的市场反馈，导致均衡难以计算。本文关注的核心问题是：在多种典型自动竞价模型中，精确计算均衡的计算复杂性究竟有多高？现有研究已知其属于FIXP类，但是否为完全问题仍属开放。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究四种主流自动竞价模型：第二价格ROI调节、预算或ROI约束的广义第二价格（GSP）拍卖、以及第二价格节流。在这些模型中，每个广告主通过一个标量参数（如乘数或参与概率）控制其竞价行为，目标是在满足预算或ROI约束的前提下最大化价值。均衡要求每个广告主在约束紧致时无法通过调整参数获益，从而形成一种互补条件，导致市场参与者之间存在强耦合。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明了上述四类模型的精确均衡计算均为FIXP-完全问题，解决了多个长期开放问题。这意味着求解这些均衡的难度与计算代数电路的不动点相当，远超PPAD类问题。此外，论文还证明了在ℓ∞距离意义下逼近均衡是FIXPa-完全的。结果表明，即使在极稀疏的竞拍结构下（如每个物品至多三名竞标者），精确均衡依然难解。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过构造从代数不动点问题到各拍卖模型的可分离线性归约来证明硬度。关键技术是设计‘算术小工具’（gadget），利用竞拍支付关系精确模拟加法、乘法等代数运算。通过补码复制控制信号扇出，确保局部构造可组合成完整电路。对于GSP模型，还需处理无自定价规则下的价格依赖，并通过供应商组机制保持发送方的均衡条件不变。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 尽管结果具有普适性，但构造依赖精细调参和理想化假设，如精确互补条件和共同优先级。这使得实际算法设计仍具挑战。然而，论文的价值在于首次确立了自动竞价均衡的精确复杂性分类，为后续研究提供了坚实理论基础。最值得阅读的是其统一的技术框架与精巧的小工具设计，尤其是对GSP中信号传输与条件保持的处理。

papers.title: Computational Aspects of Distortion
papers.titleZh: 失真度计算的若干方面
papers.abstract: The distortion framework in social choice theory allows quantifying the efficiency of (randomized) selection of an alternative based on the preferences of a set of agents. We make two fundamental contributions to this framework. First, we develop a linear-programming-based algorithm for computing the optimal randomized decision on a given instance, which is simpler and faster than the state-of-the-art solutions. For practitioners who may prefer to deploy a classical decision-making rule over the aforementioned optimal rule, we develop an algorithm based on non-convex quadratic programming for computing the exact distortion of any (and the best) randomized positional scoring rule. For a small number of alternatives, we find that the exact distortion bounds are significantly better than the asymptotic upper bounds established in prior literature and lead to different recommendations on which rules to use. These results rely on a novel characterization of the instances yielding the worst distortion, which may be of independent interest.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么仅凭选民的排序偏好做决策会带来效率损失？这是社会选择中‘失真度’框架的核心关切。已有研究给出了失真度的渐近上下界，但在实际场景中，选举往往候选人数较少，此时渐近界限无法指导规则选择。本文聚焦两个更精细的问题：如何针对具体偏好实例计算最优决策？以及如何精确计算一类自然规则的真实失真度，而非依赖粗略上界？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑n个代理人和m个备选项，每个代理人在备选项上有归一化的基数效用，但投票机制只能看到其诱导的序数偏好排名。目标是设计一个（随机化）投票规则，最小化最坏情况下社会福利与最优福利之比的上确界，即失真度。特别地，文章重点分析了一类称为随机位置计分规则（RPSR）的机制，其按预设分数向量对候选人计分，并以得分比例随机选出胜者。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文有两个核心贡献：第一，提出了一个仅含O(nm)变量和约束的线性规划，用于在给定偏好剖面下计算最优随机化决策及其失真度，比此前O(nm²)的方法更高效；第二，首次给出了计算任意RPSR确切失真度的非凸二次规划算法，并发现对于小m，常见RPSR的实际失真远优于渐近界，且随机调和规则在m≥3时表现最优，尽管其渐近界并非最好。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 关键技术在于刻画了达到最坏失真度的效用剖面结构——即‘二元效用’：每个代理人的效用在其前r个最喜好的选项上均等，其余为零。这一结构极大压缩了搜索空间。在此基础上，作者将原问题转化为线性或二次优化问题。对于寻找最优RPSR，还结合了零和博弈与线性规划辅助搜索，加速收敛。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 主要局限在于二次规划求解非凸，无法保证多项式时间求解，目前仅适用于m≤5的小规模情形。此外，最优规则虽可计算，但缺乏简洁表达式，难以直接部署。最值得阅读的是其模型洞察——二元效用刻画和由此导出的高效算法设计，为精确分析小规模选举提供了新工具，相关技术也可能推广至其他社会选择问题。

papers.title: The Geometry of Ignorance: Detecting Suppressed Knowledge in LLMs through Activation Fragmentation
papers.abstract: Evaluating whether a large language model (LLM) genuinely knows a concept remains a fundamental problem, since behavioral metrics can be fooled by suppression: a model that refuses to answer may still harbor recoverable knowledge. The framework measures the geometric coherence of \textit{anon-vectors}, the differences in hidden states between a concept-specific query and its anonymized paraphrase, and shows that genuine knowledge forms a tight, low-entropy cluster while ignorance forces geometric fragmentation. Across ten instruction-tuned LLMs from three model families, all fragmentation metrics reliably separate known from unknown concepts, and post-unlearning, fragmentation geometry correlates with adversarial recovery across four attack types and five unlearning algorithms, though the direction of that relationship is shown to depend on attack methodology. Furthermore, a layer-resolved analysis reveals that different adversarial mechanisms exploit this geometry at varying depths, with high attack-specific correlations that are invisible to behavioral evaluation. Together, these results constitute a single-phase, attack-free proxy for unlearning robustness that captures aspects of parametric knowledge inaccessible to output-level metrics. A reference implementation is available at https://github.com/AdarPeleg/geometry-of-ignorance

papers.title: Suppressing Misaligned Behaviors in Language Models, Durably
papers.abstract: Undesired model behaviors can emerge or re-emerge at any stage of training. Once observed, how effectively can we suppress them? To study this question, we first construct two model organisms--language models deliberately trained to exhibit a specific misalignment--that differ in what triggers the behavior. The narrow-trigger organism misbehaves only when the prompt contains a specific cue: it cheats on multiple-choice questions by following a planted hint that points to a wrong answer, and behaves normally otherwise. The broad-trigger organism has no such cue: after fine-tuning on insecure code, it gives harmful responses across a wide range of open-ended prompts. We then formalize post-hoc behavioral suppression and evaluate methods along three criteria: immediate suppression of the target behavior, durability under further training, and preservation of general capability. We compare standard methods--SFT, GRPO, and gradient-ascent unlearning--along these dimensions. Building on prior work on alignment shallowness, we hypothesize that more durable suppression requires the ability to recover from a wider range of misalignment states. We introduce Prefix-Expanded Adversarial Reinforcement Learning (PEARL), a GRPO variant that augments rollouts with continuations from intermediate states sampled along cached organism trajectories. Across both organism settings and two model families (Qwen3-4B, GPT-OSS-20B), PEARL achieves strong immediate suppression while preserving task accuracy, and remains durable under further fine-tuning on either the organism's data or unrelated data. It obtains the greatest benefit when the undesirable behavior is broad and cannot be addressed through targeted SFT. Together, our framework and method offer a step toward more durable post-hoc removal of undesired behaviors.

papers.title: Knowingly Wrong: Training LLMs Against Their Own Beliefs can Induce Misalignment
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) on harmful data in a narrow domain, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned. How realistic this risk is remains unclear, since models are very rarely fine-tuned on explicitly harmful data in practice. In this work, we show that fine-tuning on data the model believes to be false but that has no harmful content, can also induce broad misalignment. Across mathematics, trivia, cooking and sports, the more strongly the model disbelieves the answers it is trained on, the more misaligned it becomes. In mathematics, misaligned answers rise from 4% to over 60% as the training answers become more wrong, with little loss of general capability. After fine-tuning, the model states the wrong answers but its multiple-choice probabilities still prefer the true ones, which suggests that misalignment comes from this internal inconsistency. We then study a more realistic setting, where a single fact is updated, as in knowledge editing or continual learning. The same relationship holds and the more the model still believes the true fact after training on the false one, the more misaligned it becomes. When we frame the same false fact as part of a coherent story, the model comes to believe it more deeply and becomes less misaligned than when we instruct it to assert the false fact. Content filters and persona vectors cannot tell these two framings apart, even though they lead to different levels of misalignment. These results suggest a risk for model updates, where training a model that does not adopt the new fact as true can induce misalignment even when the data looks harmless.

papers.title: The Right Source Is Not Enough: Understanding History Interference in Speech-LLM Memory
papers.titleZh: 正确的源信息并不足够：理解语音大语言模型记忆中的历史干扰
papers.abstract: Speech large language models retain audio history to support multi-turn conversations. Yet remembering an event does not ensure that its information is used only when relevant. We investigate why irrelevant historical audio changes answers even when the queried event remains represented. Controlled experiments on MOSS-Audio and MiMo-Audio show that historical values direct errors toward specific competing answers, beyond a generic effect of context length. Causal interventions distinguish two paths. In open-ended question answering, most history-value errors disappear when subsequent computation cannot directly access the irrelevant source. In multiple-choice answering, many errors persist: early historical influence is carried by question-candidate states even after direct source access is blocked. Low-dimensional interventions further separate source-role information from answer-value information. Their effects peak at different depths, and changing the source-role signal does not eliminate the causal influence of competing values. On naturally occurring errors, strengthening the queried role and counteracting the historical value each improve answers; their joint intervention gives the greatest recovery. These findings support a failure of downstream evidence use beyond source identification alone: source-role information can influence a decision without exclusively controlling which historical values affect it. Reliable conversational memory therefore requires not only retention and retrieval, but also control over how retained information enters answer computation.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 语音大语言模型虽能记住多轮对话历史，但即使正确识别出相关事件，仍可能受无关历史信息干扰而给出错误答案。这暴露了一个核心问题：记忆的保留与检索不等于正确使用。现有研究多关注能否回忆，却忽视了信息如何参与决策，导致模型在真实对话中产生误导性输出。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究聚焦于语音大语言模型在多轮问答中的行为，输入为顺序播放的音频片段和文本问题，输出为选项标签或生成答案。通过控制历史音频的内容，构造‘目标事件’与‘干扰事件’共存的测试场景，评估模型在保持目标信息可访问的前提下，是否会被干扰事件的答案值误导。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文发现，即使屏蔽直接访问干扰源，其答案值仍能持续影响模型决策，尤其是在多项选择题中。更重要的是，通过低维干预分离‘源角色’与‘答案值’的影响，证实二者独立作用于不同网络深度，且角色信号无法完全抑制竞争值的因果影响，说明错误源于下游证据整合失控而非单纯检索失败。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用因果干预方法，包括屏蔽特定源的注意力、跨条件转移中间状态，以及在隐藏层施加角色与值的正交向量扰动。这些操作构建了从早期访问到后期决策的因果路径，验证了干扰信息一旦被编码进问题-候选状态，即可绕过后续访问限制持续发挥作用。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 实验基于特定语音模型和合成数据，结论普适性有待验证；干预依赖已知源边界，难以直接转化为实用修复方案。但论文的价值在于揭示了记忆使用的深层机制缺陷。最值得细读的是其因果分析框架和对‘角色-值’分离的实证，这对设计更可靠的对话系统具有指导意义。

papers.title: Artifact-to-Capability: Diagnosing Breaks in Capability Formation of Self-Evolving Agents in a Controlled Environment
papers.abstract: Self-evolving agents write interaction experience into artifacts and reuse them in later tasks. Most work supports such methods with three proxy signals: artifacts accumulate, behavior changes once they are loaded, and metrics rise. We call this signal-based evaluation. What these signals are meant to indicate, however, has not been defined. To fill this gap, we define capability formation from artifacts as five sequentially dependent properties, two of which form a checkpoint for capability formation, and introduce three-scale diagnosis, which judges these properties at the state, game, and lineage levels. In freestyle Gomoku, Reflexion, Voyager, and DGM evolve with the same base model and all show the three signals, yet each exhibits a distinct capability-formation break. Reflexion shows a legalization gain: its pass rate rises only because more of its moves are legal. Voyager shows a compositional override: components that are sound on their own combine to miss all 20 available one-move wins. DGM shows loss-only drift: after passing the checkpoint, later versions only lose passing states. These counterexamples show that signal-based evaluation cannot determine whether a capability has formed.
